description: A company's own disclosures: filed 8-K events, its press releases, the text of those 8-Ks, and governance red flags (late filings, auditor changes, selling clusters). Use when the user asks: any red flags at X; what did X announce; latest 8-K from X. Not 10-K/10-Q sections. Args: entity; kind = events | press_releases | event_text | red_flags.

entity.description: The company: a ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), a company name (Apple) or an SEC CIK.
entity.title: Entity

kind.description: "events" (default): filed 8-K events and how significant; "press_releases": the company's own releases; "event_text": the text of the latest filed events; "red_flags": late filings, auditor changes and insider-selling clusters.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: Most records to return, newest first. For events it counts the 8-K filings; the declared dividends, insider trades and sentiment reading beside them come in addition, up to as many of each.
limit.title: Limit

name: get_filings
title: SEC filings & events
